Considering all of this, I think a slight adjustment to my ranking is strategically wise. If I only rank w, z, x, y, and w is extremely competitive, I might end up with nothing.

I'm going to slightly elevate y in my ranking. It's still last, but closer to x than before. This acknowledges the market's preference for y while still expressing my true desires. I'm betting that being a high priority at y, combined with its popularity, will give me a reasonable chance of getting in there if w doesn't pan out.
